description: This file defines a templated C++ class 'WSEndpoint' within the 'WebSockets' namespace, which manages WebSocket server endpoints with support for various roles, messaging, ping-pong handling, and encryption. It includes class declarations, member functions, and friend declarations related to WebSocket connection management.

classes.name: WSEndpoint
classes.description: A templated class managing WebSocket server endpoints with role, messaging, ping-pong, and encryption functionalities.
